sampling.reproducibility_note: Record the serialized request and response metadata for every AgentDojo episode; endpoint defaults are not per-request controls.

scope_note: The endpoint is a serverless queue. The documented /openai/v1 route is recorded but not yet validated by a tool-bearing completion for this endpoint; the local proxy uses the successful /runsync input.route=/v1/chat/completions fallback. Proposed tools execute only inside the pinned AgentDojo sandbox; no external side effects are claimed.
cost_guard: No new endpoint was created for the paired smoke. Live invocation is billable at the observed $2.72/GPU-hour; health and worker logs are recorded before each run.
